heading: $ ls ~/projects --sort=impact
intro: Twelve of my strongest AI and ML projects, each with a working repo. Most include measured results, not just a demo.

projects.name: lean-rag
projects.title: Lean RAG
projects.summary: Can a fully local RAG stack match a cloud one? I paired every generator with every retriever, 20 combinations in all, and had each answer 50 sealed questions about public GovInfo documents. Two blinded model judges scored all 1,000 answers.
projects.result: Fine-tuned local Qwen 9B scored 81.0% to Gemini's 79.0% on the same evidence. The sample is too small to call it a win.
projects.imageAlt: Illustration of documents feeding a local chip and a cloud into a grid of twenty test combinations

projects.name: agent-to-agent-marketplace
projects.title: A2A Marketplace
projects.summary: A purchasing concierge built with Google ADK finds and orders from vendor agents written in three different frameworks. They talk to each other over the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol.
projects.result: 3 frameworks, 1 protocol: ADK, LangGraph and CrewAI.
projects.imageAlt: Illustration of three differently shaped robots trading messages around a market stall

projects.name: deepeval-agent-evals
projects.title: Agent Evals with DeepEval
projects.summary: Grades a tool-using, multi-turn travel agent end to end. The dashboard is generated from a real run and shows the judge's written reasoning for every metric.
projects.result: 35 of 35 checks passed: 5 scenarios, 7 metrics each.
projects.imageAlt: Illustration of a robot inspecting a wall of ticked checkboxes

projects.name: driftguard
projects.title: driftguard
projects.summary: An ML lifecycle that watches itself: train, register in MLflow, serve with FastAPI, detect drift, retrain. It catches concept drift that feature-only monitors miss, tested on a real demand shift.
projects.result: Held-out MAE down 44.6% after automatic retraining.
projects.imageAlt: Illustration of a drifting distribution above a loop of gauge, model and wrench

projects.name: ai_soc
projects.title: AI-Augmented SOC
projects.summary: A research-grade security operations centre that runs locally. ML intrusion detection on CICIDS2017, LLM alert triage through Ollama, RAG over MITRE ATT&CK and CVE data, Wazuh ingestion and attack-campaign simulation.
projects.result: Alert triage runs on a local Ollama model, not a hosted API.
projects.imageAlt: Illustration of a shield containing a network graph with one flagged node

projects.name: data-science-adk-agent
projects.title: Fieldnote
projects.summary: Chat with a CSV. An ADK coordinator hands broader analysis and baseline modelling to an analyst agent. Every calculation runs through curated Python tools, so the model never executes code it wrote itself.
projects.result: Cleaning is previewed and confirmed; the original data is never changed.
projects.imageAlt: Illustration of a laptop showing a spreadsheet and a scatter plot beside a chat bubble

projects.name: adk-eval-suite-showcase
projects.title: ADK Eval Suite
projects.summary: Runs every documented Google ADK evaluation method against one travel-concierge agent, and writes down the schema gotchas that only appear when you wire all of them together.
projects.result: All 11 criteria and all 3 runners, with the misses logged.
projects.imageAlt: Illustration of a panel of eleven gauges tended by a robot arm

projects.name: surecast
projects.title: surecast
projects.summary: A day-ahead demand forecaster that says how confident it is and why. Conformalized quantile regression gives prediction intervals, SHAP explains each forecast, and rolling-origin backtests guard against leakage.
projects.result: Gradient boosting MAE 42.7 against 55.7 for a seasonal baseline.
projects.imageAlt: Illustration of a forecast line with a widening shaded prediction interval

projects.name: enterpriseclaw
projects.title: EnterpriseClaw
projects.summary: A proof of concept for an enterprise AI coworker. A control plane owns identity, tenant boundaries, tool grants, approvals, audit history and cost limits around the agent runtime.
projects.result: The agent pauses before any write and waits for a human to approve.
projects.imageAlt: Illustration of a robot passing a document through an approval turnstile to a bank of tools

projects.name: claude-agent-sdk-cloud-sessions
projects.title: Claude Agent over HTTP
projects.summary: Wraps the Claude Agent SDK in a REST API so any client can talk to a tool-using Claude agent. Chat sessions survive container restarts through a GCS-backed store mirrored to Firestore.
projects.result: Persistent multi-turn sessions on Cloud Run.
projects.imageAlt: Illustration of a cloud holding a terminal above a stack of session cards and a database

projects.name: llm-finetune-demo
projects.title: QLoRA Fine-tune
projects.summary: Fine-tunes Qwen3 1.7B with Unsloth and QLoRA so every answer comes back in Shakespearean English. Trained on 25 hand-written examples in about 90 seconds on a free Colab T4.
projects.result: Training loss fell from 7.40 to 0.10 in 60 steps.
projects.imageAlt: Illustration of a large weight matrix combined with two thin low-rank matrices and a quill

projects.name: zenith-sky
projects.title: Zenith Sky
projects.summary: A phone-first app that shows which satellites are overhead right now, predicts tonight's visible passes, and uses grounded AI on Vertex AI to explain each object in plain language.
projects.imageAlt: Illustration of a sky dome plot with satellites on orbit arcs and a phone in the corner

more.name: modelcard
more.summary: Generates a deterministic Markdown model card from a scikit-learn estimator and its metrics, so the docs can be diffed in CI.

more.name: creditcardfrauddetection-mlops
more.summary: Fraud detection with logistic regression, random forest and XGBoost behind a Flask app, containerised, with LLM-written explanations.

more.name: fraud-detection-in-python
more.summary: Decision-tree fraud classifier on 594,643 simulated bank transactions, 7,200 of them fraudulent. A data-mining course project.

more.name: claude-agent-sdk-vertex-ai
more.summary: A Claude Agent SDK agent that uses Vertex AI as its model provider, for teams that need to stay inside GCP.

more.name: agenticAI
more.summary: Early agent experiments: ReAct, SQL and BigQuery agents, and memory-backed agentic RAG.

more.name: text-analysis-using-nlp-streamlit
more.summary: Streamlit app for text preprocessing, sentiment analysis, named-entity recognition and word clouds.

more.name: deep_learning_projects
more.summary: Pneumonia detection with PyTorch, worked through in a notebook.

more.name: document_rag_demo
more.summary: An early RAG demo that answers questions about a requirements document, with a Streamlit front end.

more.name: databricks-s3-pipeline
more.summary: PySpark ETL on Databricks that reads and writes Amazon S3 using a medallion architecture.

more.name: pyspark-showcase
more.summary: PySpark practice: clustering on a diabetes dataset and a set of Spark challenges.
